eoriNumbers.title: EORI numbers
eoriNumbers.description: Required unless datasetId is set. Strings with the country prefix, e.g. ["GB117223643000","BE0403448140","XI220430231000"]. Spaces and dashes are fine. Add " | Expected name" to compare names, e.g. "GB117223643000 | Apple Distribution International". GB goes to HMRC; EU and XI to the EU EOS service.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Optional 2-letter code (e.g. "DE" or "GB") used for numbers without a country prefix.

maxNumbers.title: Max numbers
maxNumbers.description: Check at most this many unique numbers per run (default 5000). Aliases: maxItems, limit, maxResults.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read EORI numbers from another run's dataset, e.g. a supplier export. In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

eoriField.title: EORI field in that dataset
eoriField.description: Field holding the EORI (dot paths work). Leave empty to auto-detect: eori, eoriNumber, EORI, eori_number, eoriNo, customsId.

nameField.title: Company name field in that dataset
nameField.description: Optional field compared with the official trader name (nameMatch). Leave empty to auto-detect: companyName, name, company, legalName, traderName.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 1000).

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries per batch of 10 when a service is busy or offline (0-6, default 3).
